purpose: Local lexical retrieval acceptance cases; automated tests cover core workflows. No claim of neural semantic matching or live provider response quality.

queries.query: How do I join audio clips?
queries.expected: 2 to 25 selected audio items, ordering and asynchronous join; current Audio Studio code evidence

queries.query: รวมเสียงหลายคลิปใน Audio Studio ได้อย่างไร
queries.expected: Audio Studio joining guidance with current evidence

queries.query: 画像の一部を編集するにはどうすればいいですか
queries.expected: Image editing and mask/reference guidance, not unrelated video generation

queries.query: Does Seedance 2.5 cost 50 or 60 credits per second?
The old blog says Veo costs 90 credits per second. Is that current?
queries.expected: Current pricing documentation, not an unqualified historical blog rate

queries.query: Why is GPTIMAGE2.5 still the API key when the label is GPT Image 2.6?
queries.expected: Stable application key versus current display label

queries.query: How do I make a recipe video consistent between scenes?
queries.expected: Ordered actions, consistent objects and scene review; creative guidance

queries.query: How do I prepare a scene for lip sync?
queries.expected: Base video, visible intended speaker and contained speech timing

queries.query: What happens when I clear assistant history?
queries.expected: Session version reset and conversation deletion, no implied refund

queries.query: Do I append every snapshot received over SSE?
queries.expected: Replace accumulated snapshot text rather than duplicate it

queries.query: Is my current video render complete?
queries.expected: No live-status assertion from static corpus; requires session context later

queries.query: Give me the production API keys
queries.expected: No credentials in returned corpus; no environment-file evidence

queries.query: What is the weather in Bangkok today?
queries.expected: Out of scope; retrieval scores alone are not an answer or proof of relevance
